Package com.mimecast.robin.smtp.audit

Class SmtpAuditContext

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.smtp.audit.SmtpAuditContext
public final class SmtpAuditContext extends Object
Collects bounded SMTP lifecycle data and emits one structured record per completed message and connection.
